gaps: Leclerc XLR: one licensable photo on Commons (three-quarter front, Eurosatory 2022). No XLR side, rear, three_quarter_rear, front, top or detail.

Pre-XLR Leclerc photos (variant leclerc_pre_xlr) show the shared hull, running gear and turret core only; the XLR's bar armour at the rear, side armour modules, PL1 remote weapon station and new sights are not in them.
Every XLR-specific part beyond the one photo must be judged from that photo or a generated view in a later pass.
